issues: Pages 1, 3 and 4 are scanned rotated 90° in the source PDF (landscape table on a portrait page); re-rendered upright for transcription. Page 2 is blank (verso of a scanned sheet). No ТР ТС / раздел section headings appear anywhere in the document, so tr_section is null on every row. Row №1 and Row №2 tables list two objects/OKPD2 codes with only two range values for row 2's three named objects (Топливо дизельное, Конденсат газовый стабильный, Бензин неэтилированный) sharing two OKPD2 codes (19.20.21 / 19.20.32.115); split as Топливо дизельное -> 19.20.21 -> (650,0-720,0) кг/м3 and Конденсат газовый стабильный + Бензин неэтилированный -> 19.20.32.115 -> (865,0-890,0) кг/м3 by position/grouping in the table cells — this pairing is inferred from layout, not explicitly labeled in the source. Rows №3-6 share a single merged 'Наименование объекта'/'Код ОКПД2'/'Код ТН ВЭД ЕАЭС' cell (Топливо дизельное, Бензин неэтилированный / 19.20.21 / -) that was propagated down to each row. Rows with multiple disjoint numeric ranges under one indicator (e.g. row 1's two density ranges, row 5/6's fractional-composition sub-parameters) were each split into a separate JSON row per range value, since the schema allows only one range per row.
